headline: ADM to Expand North America Crush Capacity Amid Strong Biofuel Demand
summary: CHICAGO, July 30, 2026--ADM (NYSE: ADM), a global leader in innovative solutions from nature, today announced a series of investments designed to expand North American oilseed crush capacity and strengthen the company's ability to meet growing demand for renewable fuels and other vegetable oil markets.
